qualification.details: Accountant: B.Com from a recognized University/Institution. Knowledge of Tally/Accounting software and computer application is desirable. Prefer fluency in Hindi and English. Staff Nurse: B.Sc. Nursing / B.Sc. (Hons.) Nursing / Post Basic B.Sc. Nursing from a recognized University/Institution; registered as Nurse/Nurse Midwife with a State Nursing Council. Relevant hospital experience is desirable. Hostel Warden – Male & Female: Bachelor's Degree from a recognized University/Institution. Experience in hostel/residential school management is desirable. Mess Helper: Class X Pass from a recognized Board/Institution. Experience in mess/kitchen work is desirable. Junior Secretariat Assistant: Senior Secondary (Class XII) Pass from a recognized Board/Institution with minimum typing speed of 35 w.p.m. in English or 30 w.p.m. in Hindi. Basic computer knowledge desirable. Cook: Class X Pass from a recognized Board/Institution. Experience in cooking, preferably in a hostel/school/institutional kitchen, is desirable. Chowkidar/Security: Class X Pass from a recognized Board/Institution. Experience in security/watch and ward duties is desirable. Sweeper: Class X Pass from a recognized Board/Institution. Experience in sanitation/cleaning work is desirable. Electrician-cum-Plumber: Class X Pass plus ITI/Polytechnic Certificate or higher qualification in Electrician/Wireman trade. Relevant experience in electrical and plumbing work is desirable. Driver: Class X Pass from a recognized Board/Institution. Experience/knowledge in driving, and maintenance of vehicle is desirable.
